text.p: Investment firm Hudson Conway Ltd said on Monday that a settlement had been reached in a property dispute involving it, Foster's Brewing Group, the former Gas and Fuel Corp of Victoria, the Victoria state government and Gleem Pty Ltd.

"All claims and counter claims in legal proceedings relating to a proposed development and lease of a new head office building for Gas and Fuel Corp of Victoria have been settled," Hudson Conway said.
"Under the settlement, no payments will be made by any party to the proceedings and each such party will bear its own costs of the litigation," the company said.
The settlement is in the best interests of Hudson Conway shareholders because it avoids protracted and expensive litigation, Hudson Conway chief executive Lloyd Williams said in a statement.

Gleem, a joint venture company involving Hudson Conway and Foster's, had sought A$100 million in damages over the Gas and Fuel Corp's 1993 decision not to proceed with a 20-year lease agreement on an office development Hudson Conway proposed for inner Melbourne.
